mentions.name: tsdevstack
mentions.description: Open-source TypeScript microservices framework that generates and deploys entire production-grade cloud infrastructure (VPC, gateway, WAF, observability, CI/CD) from a single config file, with multi-cloud support across GCP, AWS, and Azure. Includes an MCP server so AI agents can understand the framework and help with development and stack management.
mentions.problem: Repetitively writing the same Terraform, gateway config, and CI/CD setup for every TypeScript project.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building tsdevstack - Infrastructure as Framework

It's an open-source TypeScript microservices framework. It generates and deploys an entire production-grade cloud infrastructure (VPC, gateway, WAF, observability, CI/CD) from a single config file. Multi-cloud across GCP, AWS, and Azure.
